interactions.target_raw: Mediator of RNA polymerase II transcription subunit 23
interactions.note: The epitope of nanobody Nb106 on MED23 was determined from the crystal structure of the complex. The structure of the MED23-Nb106 complex was solved de novo by multiple isomorphous replacement. Nb106 was used as a crystallization chaperone. MED23 belongs to the Tail module of Mediator, whose main function is to connect Mediator to sequence-specific transcription factors.; Unmapped quantitative response: 3D structure 2.8 angstroms
